## What this deck is for

This deck is the twin of the other one, rendered without the filter, so the two heads can be compared.

Its head carries only the tags Quarto emits by itself.

## Where the values came from

The front matter uses the standard Quarto keys: `title`, `description`, `site-url`, `image`, `open-graph`, and `twitter-card`.

Nothing under `extensions.social` is set here, which is the usual case.

## What is missing here

Quarto writes twelve social tags for this deck by itself.

Absent from this head are the seven the filter adds, `og:url` and `og:type` among them.
